title: Rollout Orchestra: unified telemetry hub for canaries, A/Bs, and shadow traffic
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Create a single Console hub (Rollout Orchestra) that surfaces unified telemetry for canary rollouts, A/B tests, and shadow traffic. The hub should let operators compare cohorts side‑by‑side, inspect per-route traces, view delta metrics with statistical significance indicators, and trigger auto-rollback recommendations. Focused on developer workflows: fast triage, hypothesis validation for regressions, and safe automated remediation.
acceptance_criteria: Console has a Rollout Orchestra entry point that lists active rollouts (canary/A-B/shadow) with status badges and quick filters
Users can open a cohort-compare view that shows baseline vs variant time-series for latency, token-cost, error-rate, and a configurable serving-side metric
Cohort-compare view displays sample traces side-by-side with trace links to the trace viewer and highlights divergence points (model version switch, route changes)
Delta metrics show relative change, absolute delta, and a significance flag computed with a default test (e.g., bootstrap CI or t-test)
Auto-rollback recommendations are surfaced when predefined thresholds are breached and an operator can 1-click schedule a rollback or create a rollback runbook
Shadow traffic panel aggregates divergence stats and provides a small-sample replay tool to compare outputs for selected requests
Rollouts are correlated to per-route costs and units consumed (token breakdown) in the same view
RBAC respects existing Console roles; non-admins see telemetry but cannot trigger rollbacks unless permissioned
Telemetry retention, sampling rates, and query performance are within SLOs documented in the engineering dependency
Design mockups and an initial API contract are linked and approved by PM, Design, and Eng leads
design_notes: Primary screen is a table of rollouts (filterable by route, model, status, owner). Clicking a rollout opens the Orchestra canvas with three panes: 1) Overview metrics & delta sparkline, 2) Cohort time-series with significance shading, 3) Trace sampler + output diff inspector. Provide keyboard shortcuts for common triage flows. Mockups show colorblind-friendly palettes and compact density for power users.
engineering_notes: Backend work includes a rollout-index API, cohort-compare aggregator, and a delta-stats microservice (statistical testing library reused from evals). Frontend work: new Console routes, charting components for cohort diffs, trace links. Key perf requirement: cohort compare queries must return <1200ms for 24h slices at 1M requests/day scale. Depend on ENG-27418 (trace-link propagation) and ENG-28951 (delta-stats service).
metrics_to_track: response-divergence-rate (semantic output diff) for shadow traffic
time_to_detection (time from breakpoint to dashboard alert)
links: https://sentry.redwood.ai/issue/ROLL-455 (related incident: missed drift during canary)
tasks: Finalize PRD and sig-off from Reliability and Security
Design handoff: detailed HRT and accessibility review
Eng: implement rollout-index API and cohort-compare aggregator
Eng: integrate delta-stats service and add significance flags
Frontend: build Orchestra canvas and charting components
QA: create synthetic regression tests using shadow replays
Ops: define alerting rules and rollout auto-rollback policy templates
Docs: update Console runbook and quickstart for rollout observability
decisions: Default statistical test: bootstrap 95% CI for non-normal metrics; t-test for normally distributed metrics (documented in PRD)
Auto-rollback will be opt-in per-project with a two-step confirmation and guardrail time window
Sampled traces will default to 1% for production rollouts, adjustable per-rollout
Shadow replay outputs will be stored for 7 days by default and included in telemetry cost calculations
blockers: ENG-27418 - trace context propagation fixes needed to reliably join traces to rollouts
Quota for analytics queries: need backend scaling before enabling 90-day history
Legal review for storing model outputs from customer traffic (shadow replay)
notes: Coordination with Dedicated and Private teams required: rollout canvas must surface whether variant is running on Dedicated pools or Private deployments and gracefully handle cross-environment comparisons. Plan a staged rollout of Orchestra: internal alpha -> select customers (beta) -> general availability. Track telemetery cost impact and iterate on sampling and aggregation strategies to keep cost neutral for small customers.
